description: Returns a ready-to-chart series of new MCP servers per UTC day for the last N days (1 to 365). The last day can be partial, see snapshot_at. Example output: {"days":3,"series":[{"date":"2026-10-23","new_servers":551}]}. Optional argument: days, default 30. With no arguments you get 30 days. Good for 'Show daily new MCP servers over the last two weeks'.

days.description: Number of days back from the snapshot date, 1 to 365. Optional, default 30.
days.title: Days

name: daily_new_counts
